Alert PRH-AUTH-002 (high): Password spraying or credential stuffing from one IP

recommended_actions: Block or rate-limit the source IP and add a bot check to the sign-in form.
Force a password reset for targeted accounts that signed in successfully afterwards, and end their sessions.
Encourage or require two-step verification for the targeted accounts.
Check the targeted addresses against known breach data if your policy allows it.
limitations: Enrichment not run: IP reputation and location were not considered
Single log source (app-security): no other log corroborates it
Possible benign cause for PRH-AUTH-002: An office or campus NAT where several users mistype their passwords at the same time
Possible benign cause for PRH-AUTH-002: Automated sign-in tests run against several test accounts
